environment: Node host with real application HVAC/Flow functions and mocked Homey transport; no Homey hardware measurement
passed: Five known independent sources change in one pass; unchanged targets do not republish or start learning
Known sources proceed while unknown sources retain global priority and interval fallback
Direct tariff changes bypass an active global timer for all configured devices and suppress automatic learning
One heat pump with four thermostats reserves one full source plus modulation margin, and all zones can change
Shared zones never assume free additional load; unsafe source capacity, invalid parents and cycles are blocked
Parallel independent sources share Peak Guard and HVAC budget instead of each reusing the same margin
Fresh grid budget exceedance requests an urgent context once and sheds running outputs without priority wait
Peak Guard and stale P1 reduce permanent HVAC immediately, even inside the start interval
Direct PV requires sustained surplus, shares available watts and respects stop hysteresis
Settings/grid/battery/tariff changes during awaited Flow publication invalidate remaining batch increases
Automatic-control Flow supports optional standby on all ten slots and emits actual OFF, respecting both permissions
Old numbered and deprecated selector Flows keep missing-argument semantics and preserve standby after restart
Manual learning queues one reliable independent step; connected EV, active boiler, short intervals and unstable baselines block it
Learning accepts a stable manual plateau, retains prior watts on interference and restores the ordinary target
Automatic learning stays single-source; direct flags, queued manual work and real external changes prevent contaminated automatic results
Known legacy PV units start together with their original half-degree steps; ongoing demand remains reserved
Direct legacy PV waits for stability and budget reductions reuse the existing restoration controller
A boiler start and parallel HVAC reserve combined physical headroom
Manual requests survive an unsafe opportunity and a restart restores an interrupted probe without discarding learned power
Stable PV requests one immediate existing context from meter feedback, without adding a timer or planning there
A disabled module and a removed permanent slot send the allowed OFF, and a standby argument works while the module is disabled
Manual learning also uses an ordinary legacy PV demand step when safe
Shared source modes change together when all linked thermostats agree; conflicting modes remain blocked
Re-enabling while an OFF Flow is awaiting completion restores ON through the existing latest-wins publication slot
Ten-slot settings defaults are off; active Flow extension is optional and deprecated cards remain byte-identical
